text:
lina (finance): Heads-up — cloud vendor announced ~14% GPU price increase in APAC this morning. Need a fast pricing/packaging impact analysis: how does this affect Dedicated commitments, Hosted unit economics, and margin assumptions? cc @alex (eng-infra) @sam (finance) :thinking:

alex (eng-infra): Saw the notice. Impact concentrated in ap-southeast-1 + ap-northeast-1. Our Dedicated fleet there is ~120 H100-equivalent pods/day. Rough back-of-envelope: 14% on top of baseline daily GPU spend -> ~+$5.9k/day (ballpark). Can we shift batch workloads to eu-west while we evaluate? Latency-sensitive Hosted traffic needs to stay local.

alex (eng-infra): ```calc
baseline_daily_gpu_cost = $42,000
increase_pct = 0.14
extra = baseline_daily_gpu_cost * increase_pct # = $5,880/day
```

sam (finance): Quick scenario framing: 1) Absorb the increase (we eat margin) — short-term retention good, margin down ~2.3ppt on Hosted; 2) Pass-through surcharge for Dedicated/reserved SKUs — preserves margin but sales/customer friction; 3) Region-tiered surcharge or routing policy (apac surcharge, eu free) — more complex ops but minimizes PLG churn. I'll run the sensitivity and post a small table.

karen (product): Product implications: for Dedicated customers with existing commits we should consider grandfathering (90d) to avoid contract disputes. For Hosted, prefer operational mitigations first (batching, quantization recommendations, model switch) before any visible price changes. Any per-token uplift would affect PLG funnels.

ops_ryan (eng-sre): I can shift non-latency batch jobs to eu-west and start spot/borrow pools, but note cross-region egress and cold-starts. Need a list of tenants with region constraints (gov/regulatory or enterprise customers pinned to apac).

billing-bot: Automated note — preliminary invoice forecast updated. Projected monthly delta if prices persist: ~$180k. See /billing/forecast/1987654321 for details.

lina (finance): Action items: Alex — share a quick sheet with cluster-level cost delta by 12:30pm. Sam — margin-impact table for the 3 scenarios and recommended price deltas for Hosted tokens vs Dedicated monthly SKUs. Karen — draft customer comms options and grandfathering language. Ops_ryan — export tenant region constraints and estimate the % of traffic we can safe-shift. Exec one-pager by 5pm please. :white_check_mark:

alex (eng-infra): Will drop an initial spreadsheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEFghi (view-only). I'll include per-cluster hourly delta, affected pool names, and quick routing patch to prefer eu-west for background jobs.

sam (finance): I'll populate scenario sheet with: current gross margin, margin-with-absorb, margin-with-pass-through, and suggested Dedicated surcharge scenarios (flat vs tiered). Early read: a ~11% surcharge on committed SKU rates would roughly neutralize the margin hit for Dedicated.

karen (product): Also flagging communication cadence: we should provide 6 weeks notice for price changes and offer a 1-month credit for legacy large tenants to reduce churn risk.

ops_ryan (eng-sre): Pushed tenant export to the sheet and added a short note: "~18% of committed capacity is region-pinned to apac; ~62% of batch can be shifted." Also: network egress in eu-west slightly higher for some tenants, so net savings for full shift are smaller.

lina (finance): Thanks everyone. If the vendor confirms this is sustained vs one-off spike, we'll need product + sales signoff for any pass-through. For now prioritize the spreadsheet + margin table and convene a 30m sync at 3pm if needed.

alex (eng-infra): Ping me if you want the routing patch as a one-line change to the placement policy; I can pre-approve and roll it with a canary.

sam (finance): Sharing the margin table in 45m. If anyone has hard numbers for on-prem/private customer pass-through constraints, drop them here.

karen (product): I'll draft comms and a couple of PRFAQ lines for leadership review.

ops_ryan (eng-sre): Will monitor capacity and report back if spot pools start to degrade.

billing-bot: Reminder: if we change public pricing, update /pricing/canonical and push a changelog entry.

lina (finance): Great. Lean, fast, and visible.
